title: #416 Electric Vehicle
prompt: Do you agree that electric vehicles will completely replace fuel-powered cars?

promptSegments.text: Do you agree that electric vehicles will completely replace fuel-powered cars?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Electric cars are better for the environment because they do not put bad smoke into the air, unlike cars using gas, which cause pollution and dirty air.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Electric cars are better for the environment because they do not put bad smoke into the air, unlike cars using gas, which cause pollution and dirty air.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, electric cars are more convenient for daily life because they can be charged at home or at work, ensuring power when needed.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, electric cars are more convenient for daily life because they can be charged at home or at work, ensuring power when needed.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Fuel-powered cars are still needed for long trips because electric cars have limited range.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Fuel-powered cars are still needed for long trips because electric cars have limited range.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Gas cars will remain popular because the cost of building and fixing them is a known and easy process for mechanics.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Gas cars will remain popular because the cost of building and fixing them is a known and easy process for mechanics.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Electric vehicles provide a cleaner alternative for personal travel because they do not release harmful exhaust into the air.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Electric vehicles provide a cleaner alternative for personal travel because they do not release harmful exhaust into the air.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The transition is supported by growing energy sources, such as renewable energy, which are becoming cheaper to use.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The transition is supported by growing energy sources, such as renewable energy, which are becoming cheaper to use.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The argument focuses on the limitations of electric vehicles (EVs) in terms of infrastructure and range, suggesting that fuel-powered cars will remain necessary for certain types of travel.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The argument focuses on the limitations of electric vehicles (EVs) in terms of infrastructure and range, suggesting that fuel-powered cars will remain necessary for certain types of travel.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point argues that EVs are not suitable for all transportation needs, specifically citing the requirements of heavy commercial vehicles (trucks and buses) that still rely on powerful fuel engines.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point argues that EVs are not suitable for all transportation needs, specifically citing the requirements of heavy commercial vehicles (trucks and buses) that still rely on powerful fuel engines.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
